subject.title: feat(talk): describe_view inline vision for OpenAI Realtime + Gemini Live

question: Should OpenClaw accept a browser-direct `describe_view` Video Talk feature that lets same-origin Control UI code request camera access and send user-approved frames directly to OpenAI Realtime or Gemini Live?
rationale: The change touches camera permission policy, model-callable tool behavior, provider-direct image delivery, and a draft feature boundary, so automation cannot safely decide the product/security direction.

options.title: Scope And Prove Before Merge
options.body: Proceed only after camera permission is scoped to the Control UI surface, provider denial behavior is consistent, conflicts are resolved, and redacted real provider proof is attached.

options.title: Pause For Broader Transport Design
options.body: Hold this draft until maintainers decide whether the provider/Gateway video-frame transport in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89131 should come first.

options.title: Accept Current Browser-Direct Boundary
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the shared camera policy and current provider behavior, but that should be a visible security/product approval.

recommendation.title: Scope And Prove Before Merge
recommendation.body: Proceed only after camera permission is scoped to the Control UI surface, provider denial behavior is consistent, conflicts are resolved, and redacted real provider proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The live PR is assigned to this login and the current-main history shows the strongest recent ownership signal across Talk/UI surfaces.
